package.name: vlm
package.description:
Team Xiao Hei AI module. Starts a router that reads the question and picks the stack that answers it: instruction-following is driven in process (VLM grounding + lidar lift + waypoints); numerical is answered there too; object reference hands over to scene_claude.launch (question-directed navigation + perception scene graph + Claude).
The `dummy_vlm` package beside this one is a launch-only shim that forwards to this package, so the evaluation's documented `ros2 launch dummy_vlm dummy_vlm.launch` keeps working.
